items.title: Mama's Egusi 🍲
items.fact: Egusi soup is rich in fibre and protein from the egusi seeds and vegetables.
items.activity: her home kitchen full of cultural details
narration: My mornings are stiff, my dear. At our age, warm meals help.
So I do this: I start by boiling the egusi seeds. Then I prepare the vegetables.
Next, I chop the onions and peppers. I use a sharp knife safely.
After that, I add the chopped vegetables to the pot. I let it simmer gently.
This egusi soup helps me feel warm and comforted. It's gentle on my stomach.
Try making egusi soup tomorrow, my friends, and tell me how it warms your heart. Share your own recipes with me.
items.description:
Learn how to make traditional Nigerian egusi soup with Mama Ngozi. This recipe uses egusi seeds, onions, peppers, and your choice of protein. Try making it tomorrow and share in the comments how it turned out for you. Don't forget to subscribe for more recipes and tips from Mama Ngozi.
